PLAN "12-Week Postpartum Return to Movement"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
GOAL primary recovery
name "Restore pelvic floor and deep core function safely"
END GOAL
GOAL secondary strength
name "Rebuild full-body strength progressively after C-section"
END GOAL
GOAL tertiary wellbeing
name "Support energy, posture, and confidence in the postpartum period"
END GOAL
END GOALS

PHASES
PHASE "Phase 1 — Gentle Reactivation" (2 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 20m "Breath and pelvic floor foundations"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
pelvic_tilt 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
cat_cow 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
spinal_twist 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 20m "Gentle mobility and glute wake-up"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
glute_bridge 3x10 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
hip_circles 2x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
pigeon_pose 45 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 20m "Posture and upper body activation"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
external_rotation 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
prone_T 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
shoulder_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
END WEEK
WEEK 2
DAY Monday training 25m "Breath and pelvic floor — adding load"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes
END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds

cat_cow 3x8 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
bird_dog 3x8 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
child_pose 60 seconds
spinal_twist 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Wednesday training 25m "Glute and hip mobility"
WARMUP

END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
diaphragmatic_breathing 2x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
hip_abduction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 45 seconds
hip_circles 2x10 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
butterfly_stretch 45 seconds
pigeon_pose 45 seconds
hip_flexor_stretch 30 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
DAY Friday training 25m "Posture and upper body — progression"
WARMUP

END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
scapular_retraction 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
external_rotation 3x12 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
prone_Y 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
prone_W 3x10 rpe 4 rest 30 seconds
END MAIN
COOLDOWN
chest_stretch 30 seconds
lat_stretch 30 seconds
child_pose 60 seconds
END COOLDOWN
END DAY
END WEEK
END PHASE
PHASE "Phase 2 — Foundation Building" (4 weeks)
WEEK 1
DAY Monday training 30m "Lower body and core integration"
WARMUP
walking 5 minutes

END WARMUP
MAIN straight_sets
